scope: Local source candidates; strict HTTP/1.x heads and body framing plans only; no body decoder, network client, SDK promotion or publication
ownership: Move-only parser, immutable shared owned head metadata, borrowed Push spans, exact consumed head prefix, writer-owned NetBuffer output
profile_limits: Origin-form and OPTIONS * requests only; HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1 parsing; HTTP/1.1 writing
ASCII reg-name subset/bracketed IPv6 Host; no userinfo, percent-encoded hosts or zones
Reject every duplicate/list Content-Length and duplicate Transfer-Encoding; only one chunked coding accepted
Reject TE/CL conflicts, forbidden framing on 1xx/204/CONNECT success, bare LF, obs-fold and unsafe field controls
Body plans never allocate the advertised length; body/trailer decoding, body limits, adapters, URL/redirect/pool policy remain H2/H3
Upgrade/Tunnel are context-dependent framing handoffs, not negotiation or tunneling implementation
No sanitizer/fuzzer, mobile, macOS x86_64, clean public SDK/compiler, independent CI or release claim
New package is an uncommitted local Git repository; parent gitlink and public origin remain pending
